limitations: Qt event tests use real Qt input delivery with theme/UI stubs, not Quickshell, the Omarchy shell, or real keyboard providers.
Helper tests replace IPC commands with controlled fixtures; source inspection is not native integration acceptance.
Automatic mode requires enabled Tablet Mode and a definite folded observation from a real fold sensor. Persistent Touch is the choice for tablets without one.
Normal overlay keyboards cannot provide secure lock-screen input. No authentication bypass is implemented.
No claim of official Omarchy tablet-default adoption, confirmed iPad support, marketplace approval or security audit.
No v0.3.0 release authorization for pending-live gaps has been recorded. The branch remains a draft candidate.
review_notes: Touch helper operations use whitelisted verbs, fresh resources and bounded IPC. Setup launch strings use a fixed template and strictly validated desktop IDs, not user-supplied shell programs.
View actions are serialized and generation-scoped; late responses do not change a reopened view. Status discovery is read-only.
Authoring/test files flagged by advisory scanning are repository sources; do not treat the complete source archive as an installable runtime bundle.
Wheel imports require digest-bound review, bounded/checksummed images and validated actions; no imported shortcut is executed or automatically selected.
PRs #12 and #15 are merged into v0.3.0 through f736f9e; their portable tests are integrated and extended. Native acceptance is still pending.
